As you fall to the ground, the pain fades and you are enveloped in a dark and peaceful serenity. A sense of absolution sweeps over you. The concerns of this world are no longer yours.

As you fall to the ground you feel your spirit pull away from its fleshy prison. You close your eyes but for a moment; upon opening them you see the whole spiritual world around you glowing with energy. You feel at home.
As you fall to the ground, a tunnel of light fills your vision and you feel yourself
racing forward towards your destiny. In the light you sense the presence of your god.
You will soon stand in judgment of your life's merits and faults.

As you fall to the ground, you suddenly feel your very essence ripped from the shell of your body. In an instance you find yourself standing on the precipice of eternity, an incoherent wailing emanating from the abyss below. You smile as you tumble forward into the black chasm.

As you fall to the ground you feel a rushing sensation as your essence is pulled from your body and joins the cosmos. Suddenly it's as if you are seeing the stars for the first time. You are in awe as you gaze at the breadth of eternity stretching before you.
Your quest ends in the west where you are able to buy a farm overlooking the eastern mountains bordering Thaermore.

As the weeks pass, you watch the skies in the east turn dark. You hear talk in the local tavern that the Goblins continue to overtake the lands of Thaermore. The few humans who have escaped tell of the vicious Goblin raids that have brought down Blackwater and Bastion Spire. The Commonwealth Guards are powerless, the council has been disbanded and the Chancellor has disappeared.
No one suspects what role you played in Thaermore's downfall, yet everyday you wonder if someone has become suspicious of your past. For now, you try not to worry about it.

You spend the next three days sequestered in Bastion Spire explaining your role in the recovery of the Crux of Ages. Although grateful for your actions, the Council stops short of publicly honoring you, expressing concerns over how the citizens of Thaermore would react to the truth of the events. Instead, you are given a modest reward and told not to speak of what you know. The official proclamation is that the Orakur were defeated and the Crux of Ages was recovered by the Commonwealth Guard.

Law and order are slow to return to Thaermore, but the people have hope. You purchase a small bit of land in northeastern Tangletree Forest where you build a cottage. Keeping rabbits out of your garden is all the adventure you want now.

Although you seek a quiet life, in time you grow restless. For reasons unknown, you are compelled to have your equipment near you while you sleep. You begin to have dreams of whispers in the darkness and movement in the shadows.

In the light of day these nightmares fade and your thoughts turn to more pressing matters: the leaves on the trees are changing and firewood needs cut. There is a strange chill on the wind. Winter will be here soon.
